system.details:
A clanking pressure-suit designed to allow its user to explore the depths. When you choose the Pressure suit as an aspect, it gains two of the following benefits:

  • Reinforced Lifelink - You're immune to the effects of bad air, and have the Glide style for short distances at depth by swinging from the tubing,
  • Leaf-Rubber Seals - You're immune to the effects of insect incursions, and invisible to threats that track by scent or pheromones,
  • Extraction Bellows - You're immune to the effects of drifting spores. After a scene spent under Pressure, gain a gaseous or spore-based specimen,
  • Saltwater Piping - You're immune to the effects of wandering spirits, and your suit keeps you at a safe temperature no matter surrounding heat or cold,
  • Amberglass Visor - Flanked by firefly spotlights. You can see almost perfectly in utter darkness and can shine a bright narrow beam ahead of you that cuts through spores, murk, and mists,
  • Caterpillar Chains - Reduce cut by one for you and your crewmates on all movement through the sink or drown,
  • Counterframe - You resist the effects of crezzerin, and Pressure based damage and effects.

And one drawback:
  • Coiled Tubing - You're weak to Spike and Keen damage,
  • Rusting Joints - Cut when attempting movement-based actions requiring speed or stealth,
  • Limited Air - Mark at the end of every scene you spend at depth without access to your own ship, a lowport, or other source of clean surface-grade air.
